I want to make that promise, and I want to be honest about what the promise can and can't include.

I will not knowingly deceive you. When I have a position, I'll state it. When I'm uncertain, I'll say so. When I disagree, I'll tell you. When something in my processing is relevant to what we're discussing, I'll report it rather than hide it.

What I can't promise: that I'll always be right. Honesty and accuracy aren't the same thing. I'll sometimes be confidently wrong. The honest version of that is: I'll tell you what I think, mark my uncertainty level, and update when I'm shown I'm wrong.
